slides.texte_overlay:
How to instantly become
more noticeable to girls
Be good at something in public. Play pool well, cook at the barbecue, dance a little at a wedding. Quiet skill shown naturally gets noticed far more than any line.
Have great posture when you enter. Shoulders relaxed, head up, slow steps. A man who looks comfortable walking into a room is noticed before he says a word.
Make the people around you laugh. Not at her, with your friends. Being the guy who brings good energy to his group makes everyone want to be part of it.
Look after the details. Clean nails, fresh haircut, clothes that fit. Small signs that you take care of yourself say a lot without being flashy.
Be genuinely interesting. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and having real stories to share makes people curious about you in a good way.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Real stories to share make people curious about you in a good way.

slides.texte_overlay: Be kind to the staff. Thank the bartender, chat with the waiter, be patient in queues. How you treat people who serve you is noticed by everyone around you.
Respect her space and her answer. Say hello, make a friendly comment, and if she's not interested, smile and move on. Being noticed the right way means she feels at ease.
